children: Summit Therapeutics said partner Akeso’s Phase III HARMONi-GI1 showed ivonescimab+chemo improved OS vs durvalumab+chemo in first-line advanced BTC (HR=0.75; one-sided p=0.0031), with PFS benefit (HR=0.61) and higher ORR/DCR. Safety was manageable in the China study.
